claims.claim_text: A biography of OSS regional planner John Edward de Young is a plausible but unconfirmed match for the indexed John E Deyoung.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The biography supplies the expanded middle name and an OSS Far East Desk role, but the index row supplies no service identifier, rank, assignment or biographical discriminator.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Probable candidate by full name and OSS context; insufficient for a confirmed or high-confidence linkage without a second independent index identifier or personnel file.
claims.temporal_assessment: The biography says its subject left a University of Chicago Ph.D. program for OSS; this chronology cannot yet be asserted for the indexed person.
claims.match_notes: Do not count the candidate's student institution as an employer or add it to default affiliation analytics. Inspect Box 185 and the biography's cited primary directory.

claims.claim_text: If this is the indexed person, John Edward de Young was a University of Chicago anthropology student immediately before OSS.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Densho says its subject left the Chicago Ph.D. program to become an OSS Far East Desk regional planner.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Candidate identity only; the unnumbered Box 185 index row needs independent confirmation.
claims.temporal_assessment: Explicit transition in the biography, conditional on identity; this is student status, not employment.
claims.match_notes: Retain as private review lead, not a public fact or employer-chart input.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Serge A Diab has a high-confidence match to an official Army enlistment record.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The indexed full name and nonshared protected identifier agree with official Army bulk record ordinal 2948115. No employer is named.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence: exact full name and unique protected identifier agree; Box 185 has not been inspected.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record establishes wartime identity context, not immediate pre-OSS assignment or earlier employer.
claims.match_notes: Accepted identity-only candidate in the private review file. Do not infer employer from an Army occupation code.

claims.claim_text: An Army entry shares the indexed Paul Diamantoukos identifier but names Pavlos; a separate adjacent index row also names Pavlos.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The Army bulk crosswalk found a protected-identifier agreement and a given-name conflict. The two Box 185 source rows remain separate.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Conflicting name evidence; the relationship between the Paul and Pavlos rows cannot be resolved from the index and bulk entry.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army entry does not document a predecessor employer, and its person's assignment cannot safely be attached to either row.
claims.match_notes: The warning is public; the full identifier and speculative duplicate merge are not. Side-by-side personnel-file review is required.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Goodhue Diament has a high-confidence identity match to an official Army record and an original OSS Mission to France award list.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The Army bulk entry matches the indexed name and protected identifier; a 1945 OSS award page independently prints the technical grade, name and matching protected identifier.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence: two independent official records corroborate the index's distinctive name, technical grade and nonshared protected identifier.
claims.temporal_assessment: The award documents 1945 wartime OSS service. Neither it nor the Army entry names a pre-OSS employer or establishes recruitment sequence.
claims.match_notes: The printed T-4 sits in the index's middle-initial column but is a technical grade, not a middle initial; the original award list writes Tec 4. Neither source supplies civilian employment.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Densho identifies John Edward de Young as an OSS Far East Desk regional planner, a close candidate for the unnumbered John E Deyoung index row. The row has no unique biographical or service identifier, so the candidate's University of Chicago student status is withheld pending Box 185 comparison.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect John E Deyoung's Box 185 file and the cited 1950 anthropologists directory to test the Densho identity and pre-OSS student chronology; seek any separately named civilian employer.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The indexed Louis A Dezman has no rank or service identifier. A 1936/1940 radio-amateur callbook name and postwar city-directory namesakes have no OSS Box 185 bridge and identify no pre-OSS employer.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Louis A Dezman's Box 185 file for full identity, 1940 occupation and a dated employer or institution; do not infer a job from radio-amateur registration.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Official Army bulk record ordinal 2948115 and the NARA index agree on exact full name and a nonshared protected identifier. This is an identity match only; Box 185 is unreviewed and no predecessor employer is documented.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Serge A Diab's Box 185 file for Army-to-OSS chronology and the last named civilian employer; Army occupation codes alone are insufficient.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index identifies John G Dial Jr. as a second lieutenant with a protected identifier, but discovery results for John Dial do not link rank, suffix and identifier to an independently documented pre-OSS employer.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect John G Dial Jr.'s Box 185 file for branch, full identity, assignment immediately before OSS and last civilian employer; check officer records with rank and suffix.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Official Army bulk record ordinal 4444893 and the NARA index agree on exact full name and a nonshared protected identifier. No named employer follows from the Army file.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Spyros Dialismas's Box 185 file for prior military assignment and separately documented civilian employer.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Official Army bulk record ordinal 3617746 shares the printed Paul-row protected identifier but gives the first name Pavlos, which also appears in a separate adjacent unnumbered index row. Do not merge these source rows or assign the Army biography to either until the physical files are compared.
person_updates.next_action: Compare both Diamantoukos Box 185 personnel files side by side with the Army bulk entry; resolve names and possible duplication before any employment attribution.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Pavlos Diamantoukos is a distinct unnumbered index row adjacent to Paul. The Army entry matching Paul's protected identifier uses Pavlos, creating a possible duplicate or variant that cannot be resolved online; both source rows remain separate.
person_updates.next_action: Compare Pavlos and Paul Diamantoukos Box 185 files and the Army record; do not transfer Paul's identifier or assign an employer by name similarity.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The NARA index, Army bulk record ordinal 835975 and original 19 July 1945 OSS Mission to France award list agree on distinctive name, technical grade where supplied and a nonshared protected identifier. Wartime identity is strong; no pre-OSS employer follows.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Goodhue Diament's Box 185 file for enlistment-to-OSS transfer and last civilian employer; disregard postwar corporation and family-name results for this question.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index gives Melvin Diamond a protected identifier and the unexplained note 'also AS'. Common-name discovery results lack a match on identifier and OSS context; the note cannot be expanded by inference.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Melvin Diamond's Box 185 file for the meaning of 'also AS', full identity and documented pre-OSS employer or assignment.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The printed Damon Diamondes row carries a T/Sgt grade displaced into the middle-initial column but no service identifier. Variant-spelling and obituary discovery results do not bridge a specific person to Box 185 or name a predecessor employer.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Damon Diamondes's Box 185 file for service identity, technical-sergeant assignment and last civilian employer; investigate name variants only with a second identifier.
